bagPolicy.summary: Bags do not need to be clear but must fit under your seat and measure no more than 15 inches wide, 15 inches high, or 22 inches long. All bags are subject to security screening.
allowed: Bags up to 15 inches wide, 15 inches high, or 22 inches long
prohibited: Bags larger than the specified dimensions
Electronic devices like iPads, tablets, or laptops
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available directly beneath Walt Disney Concert Hall with regular parking costing $9 and valet parking at $23. Accessible parking is available near elevators on each level.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Hollywood Bowl's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Lucques at the Circle offers a seasonal made-to-order pre-fixe menu and an exceptional wine list, curated by Suzanne Goin and Caroline Styne. This fine-dining experience is exclusive to Pool Circle ticket holders and features artisan cheese by Rodolphe Le Meunier and passion fruit pavlova with yuzu.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible seating. Accessible parking and shuttle service from accessible lots. Contact Hollywood Bowl for accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry permitted, check specific event policy.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office open from 2 hrs before showtime. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Main entrance on Highland Ave. Hollywood Bowl shuttle runs from multiple city locations.
